title: موسم الهجرة إلى الشمال
author: الطيب صالح
summary: A young man comes home to a village on the Nile after years of study in England and meets a stranger whose past there unsettles him. A short, haunting novel about two worlds and the people caught between them.

title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
author: Eric Carle
summary: A caterpillar eats his way through a week of food, from one apple on Monday to a feast on Saturday, before he wraps himself up and wakes as a butterfly. A picture book to read aloud and count along with.

title: رجال في الشمس
author: غسان كنفاني
summary: Three men from three generations try to cross the desert to Kuwait hidden in an empty water tank. A spare, powerful story of hope and silence.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
summary: A gifted, proud boy goes to a school for wizards, and in a moment of pride sets loose a shadow he must spend years hunting across the islands of Earthsea.

title: The Prophet
author: Kahlil Gibran
summary: Before he sails home, a prophet answers the questions of the people of the city he has lived in for twelve years: on love, work, children, freedom and much more.

title: حي بن يقظان
author: ابن طفيل
summary: A child grows up alone on an island, raised by a gazelle, and works out the world and its maker by his own reasoning. One of the first philosophical novels.
